value: This article showcases an institution's pioneering leadership in artificial intelligence and robotics, driven by distinguished faculty, including Nobel laureates, who lead groundbreaking research and education. The institution boasts a legacy of "firsts" in the field, from the creation of the first AI program and autonomous robots to developing self-driving vehicles and pioneering AI education with the first undergraduate major and engineering master's degrees. This innovation is underpinned by a "pro-human" philosophy, ensuring AI development augments and assists individuals.
